title: OpenAI pushes ChatGPT into patient health records
summary: OpenAI is integrating a Health feature into ChatGPT that allows users aged 18+ to connect their Apple Health data and US medical records to the chatbot, available across all subscription tiers on web and iOS platforms.
problem_solved: Making personal health records more accessible and actionable through AI-powered conversational interfaces.
why_valuable: Enables users to get AI-assisted insights from their comprehensive health data, potentially improving personal health management and awareness.
